note: The screens a compatibility session promises to render like the oracle, and the terms on which a capture pair may be compared. Owned by clonk-org/clonk-rs#587; the presentation promise in profile.json names that issue as pending evidence, and this file is the detail behind it. Screens whose artwork or branding is port-authored are compared on the `layout` term rather than pixel equality - see `comparison_terms` and `port_assets`, decided in clonk-org/clonk-rs#1298.

capture.note: One resolution and scale for every screen: a comparison across different geometry proves nothing, and 1280x720 at scale 100 is what docs/RENDERING_PARITY.md's live C++ captures already use.

tolerance.note: The software renderer is the exact oracle, so a CPU capture may not differ at all. GPU composition carries the one-byte cross-driver tolerance docs/RENDERING_PARITY.md already documents for readback.

blocker.summary: Compared 2026-08-26 against the pinned oracle: 95.94% bit-identical. Every remaining pixel is the port's own branding - its Logo.png, its version string and its footer line - plus the mouse cursor the C++ F9 capture bakes in. Excluding those four regions, 823144 pixels are 99.93% bit-identical, 100.00% within one channel step, and no pixel differs by more than one. The renderer already meets the GPU term; the product identity is what a comparison cannot pass. Decided in clonk-org/clonk-rs#1298: this screen is compared on the `layout` term instead, so the pixel result above is expected rather than a defect. It stays pending until a layout comparison is actually run. pixel.summary: Pixel equality within `tolerance`, over the whole frame minus any approved mask.
pixel.applies_to: Every screen whose pixels are all oracle-authored.

layout.summary: Widget geometry and text layout, not pixel equality: the same controls at the same rects with the same captions, wrapping and ordering. The pixel term is not applied to a screen on this term, because the port's own artwork cannot equal the oracle's at any resolution - the difference is texture detail across the whole asset, not a rounding residue.
layout.applies_to: Screens that render one or more of `port_assets`.
layout.note: Chosen over shipping the oracle's branding and 1x art inside the profile. The port's identity and its super-resolved startup art are deliberate product features, and clonk-org/clonk-rs#587 forbids masking port-version text or product features, so no mask could make a pixel term pass on these screens either.

port_assets.summary: The port's own product identity: Logo.png, the version string and the footer line.
port_assets.authority: clonk-org/clonk-rs#587 (masks may not cover port-version text or product features)

port_assets.summary: Startup backgrounds replaced with 3x art in planet/Graphics.c4g (commit d239bbb9d): StartupScenSelBG.png, StartupPlrSelBG.png, StartupNetworkBG.png, StartupDlgPaper.png, StartupPlrPropBG.png, StartupScenSelIcons.png.
